purpose: Official-executable probes for PLATFORM trailing fields, BACKGRND precedence/conflicts, grid continuation IDs, and discrete receptor inactive-option fields.

classification_policy.accepted: return code 0, official success marker present, and no E### diagnostic
classification_policy.rejected: at least one E### diagnostic or official unsuccessful marker
classification_policy.indeterminate: neither accepted nor rejected criteria are satisfied
classification_policy.observe: targeted cases collect behavior without asserting acceptance or rejection
